nodes.label: query.md BFS/DFS traversal, path, explain
nodes.rationale: BFS (default, depth 3) answers 'what is X connected to' broad-context questions; DFS (--dfs, depth-limited to 6) traces a specific chain/path; both fall back to inline NetworkX traversal of graph.json when the `graphify query` CLI is unavailable, and both save the Q&A back into the graph via `save-result` so future --update runs extract the answer as a node.
